announcements.title: Admissions Open for Session 2026-27 (Nursery to Class VIII)
announcements.body: Registrations are officially open for the academic session 2026-27. Parents and guardians can apply online through our website portal or collect the prospectus from the school administrative office between 8:30 AM and 1:30 PM (Mon-Sat). Limited seats available per section.

announcements.title: Annual Final Term Examination Date Sheet 2026
announcements.body: The final annual examination for Classes I to VIII is scheduled from March 02, 2026 to March 16, 2026. Admit cards and syllabus outlines have been distributed. Detailed subject-wise timetable is available on the school notice board and the Academics section.

announcements.title: Inter-School Science & Innovation Fair 'Vigyan Mela 2026'
announcements.body: Students from Classes IV to VIII will present working models on renewable energy, smart agriculture, and robotics on Saturday, February 28, 2026. Parents are warmly invited to attend the project demonstration exhibition in the main school auditorium.

announcements.title: 77th Republic Day Celebrations & Annual Merit Awards
announcements.body: KBS Public School celebrated the 77th Republic Day with patriotic flag hoisting, cultural dances, martial arts demonstrations, and distribution of merit certificates to academic and athletic toppers across all grades.

announcements.title: Special Winter Vacation & Cold Wave Timings Notice
announcements.body: In accordance with local district administration guidelines, school timings for the month of January were adjusted to 9:30 AM to 2:30 PM. Regular summer timings (8:00 AM to 1:30 PM) will resume from March 1st.

announcements.title: Inauguration of New STEM Robotics & Composite Science Lab
announcements.body: We are proud to announce the opening of our upgraded Composite Science Lab and hands-on STEM Robotics center equipped with experiential learning kits, digital microscopes, and IoT hardware to empower students with modern technological skills.

announcements.title: Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM) for Term-II Assessment
announcements.body: Mandatory PTM for all parents of Nursery to Class VIII will take place on Saturday, March 21, 2026 from 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM. Final progress cards will be handed over alongside one-on-one counseling with class teachers.

announcements.title: National Mathematics Day Quiz Winners Announced
announcements.body: Congratulations to Ramanujan House for clinching the 1st position in the Inter-House Mathematics Olympiad 2025. Medals and special encyclopedias were awarded to top performing students from Classes V to VIII.

teachers.name: Dr. Sarah Johnson
teachers.qualification: Ph.D. in Education, M.Sc. Physics, B.Ed.
teachers.bio: Dr. Johnson holds a doctorate in educational pedagogy with 18+ years of leadership in CBSE-affiliated institutions. She champions conceptual learning and moral discipline.
teachers.achievements: National CBSE Best Educator Award nominee; Published 6 research papers on STEM pedagogy in rural & semi-urban education.

teachers.name: Mr. Amit Kumar Singh
teachers.bio: Over 16 years of dedication to student mentoring and campus administration at KBS Public School, ensuring high institutional standards and student welfare.
teachers.achievements: Key architect of KBS Digital School Management initiative; Regional Debate Chief Adjudicator.

teachers.name: Mrs. Priya Verma
teachers.bio: Specializes in demystifying mathematics through real-world applications, logic puzzles, and active math lab simulations.
teachers.achievements: Mentored 40+ state level Ramanujan Math Olympiad medalists over the past 5 years.

teachers.name: Mr. Rajesh Pandey
teachers.bio: Passionate science educator who guides young learners in physics experiments, scientific reasoning, and amateur astronomy observations.

teachers.name: Ms. Ananya Sharma
teachers.qualification: M.A. English Literature, B.Ed., Cambridge CELTA
teachers.bio: Focuses on public speaking, phonetics, and building deep comprehension skills through interactive library reading sessions.
teachers.achievements: Founder of the KBS Annual Interschool Literary Fest; published poet in national journals.

teachers.name: Mr. Vikramaditya Rathore
teachers.bio: Brings history and social structures alive with interactive role-play mock parliaments and historical heritage field trips.
teachers.achievements: Spearheaded KBS Model United Nations (MUN) and Youth Parliament simulation.

teachers.name: Mrs. Sunita Mishra
teachers.bio: Guides children through the beauty of Hindi literature, Vedic shlokas, and foundational ethical values with warmth and kindness.
teachers.achievements: 15 consecutive years of excellence in primary foundational literacy; organized district-level Hindi poetry recitation.

teachers.name: Mr. Mohammad Tariq
teachers.qualification: MCA, B.Tech CSE, Google Certified Educator
teachers.designation: Head of Computer Science & Robotics Lab
teachers.bio: Inspires students to be creators rather than consumers of technology. Teaches logic building, algorithms, and practical programming.
teachers.achievements: Led student team to 2nd prize at National Junior Coding Hackathon 2024.

teachers.name: Ms. Kavita Saxena
teachers.bio: Dedicated to hands-on environmental education, school organic kitchen garden, and water conservation projects with children.
teachers.achievements: Earned KBS Public School the Green Campus Eco-Warrior Accreditation in 2025.

teachers.name: Mr. Devendra Yadav
teachers.qualification: M.P.Ed., NIS Certified Coach, National Athlete
teachers.bio: Former state-level 400m sprinter. Cultivates teamwork, physical fitness, discipline, and competitive sportsmanship among all pupils.
teachers.achievements: Coached 12 student champions in CBSE Regional Kho-Kho, Kabaddi and Athletics meets.

teachers.name: Mrs. Meenakshi Joshi
teachers.bio: Expert in Montessori and play-way methods, ensuring every toddler feels secure, loved, and eager to explore the world of learning.
teachers.achievements: Designed the innovative 'WonderYears' play-curriculum adopted across foundational grades.

teachers.name: Mr. Sandeep Roy
teachers.bio: Nurtures artistic expression, color theory, and traditional Indian folk art (Madhubani, Warli) among primary and middle school students.
teachers.achievements: Curator of the Annual KBS Young Artists Gallery; State Kala Utsav award recipient.

galleryAlbums.name: Annual Sports Meet 2025
galleryAlbums.description: An electrifying celebration of fitness, team spirit, and athletic triumphs. Over 400 students participated in sprint races, long jump, tug-of-war, and relay championships.

galleryAlbums.name: Science & Innovation Fair 'Vigyan Mela'
galleryAlbums.description: Young innovators showcasing solar city models, robotic arm prototypes, rainwater harvesting systems, and interactive chemical reaction setups.

galleryAlbums.name: Annual Cultural Fest 'Tarang 2025'
galleryAlbums.description: A dazzling evening of classical Kathak, folk dances, patriotic choruses, drama, and instrumental musical renditions by the talented students of KBS.

galleryAlbums.name: Republic Day & Independence Day Ceremonies
galleryAlbums.description: Patriotic parade, flag hoisting ceremonies by the Principal and Administrative Head, accompanied by student band melodies and freedom fighter tributes.

galleryAlbums.name: Art, Craft & Creative Expression Gallery
galleryAlbums.description: Showcasing student paintings, handmade clay sculptures, rangoli designs, and waste-to-wonder recycled art installations.

galleryAlbums.name: Campus Life, Smart Classrooms & Library
galleryAlbums.description: A glimpse into modern learning environments, airy ventilated classrooms, digital projector sessions, library reading corners, and verdant green grounds.
